semantic_fixtures.covers: Actual nine-mana cast, public authoritative indestructible projection, no invented activation and rejected insufficient payment without mutation.
Exact registered Forge grants to itself and later entering artifact creatures and noncreatures, excluding opposing artifacts and ordinary creatures.
Generating source ability removal disables grants regardless of timestamp; recipient ability removal follows timestamp. Actual cleanup expiry restores grants.
Live artifact gain and loss and current source and recipient controller changes affect the grant; Forge retains its ability after losing Artifact.
Disenchant may legally target indestructible Forge but cannot destroy it; marked lethal damage persists and kills after source ability removal.
Actual engine departure exposes marked lethal damage; reentry increments the same physical object's generation and emits one fresh grant.
Krark-Clan Ironworks sacrifices indestructible Forge as a cost; an indestructible artifact creature with zero toughness dies to state-based actions.
Actual Sculpting Steel entry-copy owns its generating grant, retains underlying physical identity and continues protecting artifacts after the donor leaves.
Actual Witness Protection removes the animated Forge's generating ability; removal remains effective after the Aura loses its abilities because its multi-layer effect already started.
